name: sap-llm-gateway
description: A proxy that allows applications to use OpenAI, Anthropic, and AWS Bedrock API formats to access SAP AI Core Foundation Models.
license: GNU AGPLv3 License - see the LICENSE file for details.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { require('./scripts/setup-git-hooks.js') } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sap-llm-gateway/test-utils build && pnpm --filter @sap-llm-gateway/service-key-parser build && pnpm run --recursive build
scripts.clean:all: pnpm run clean && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -name 'pnpm-lock.yaml' -delete
scripts.db:dev-setup: cd admin-db-export && pnpm install && pnpm run dev:setup

pnpm.comment: Production CVE patches via overrides: axios 1.18.0 (GHSA-gcfj-64vw-6mp9, GHSA-hcpx-6fm6-wx23, GHSA-7q8q-rj6j-mhjq, GHSA-mwf2-3pr3-8698, GHSA-jqh4-m9w3-8hp9, GHSA-mmx7-hfxf-jppx, GHSA-f4gw-2p7v-4548, GHSA-42h9-826w-cgv3, GHSA-pmv8-rq9r-6j72 and GHSA-xj6q-8x83-jv6g from the 2026-09 batch — production, both images and the npm CLI ship it; supersedes the 1.16.1 pin), sharp 0.35.4 (GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c and GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj — libvips image decoding, production: the gateway image installs sharp for src/plugins/resizeOversizedImages.ts; note this one is NOT an override — sharp is a direct "^0.35.4" spec in the services/gateway package.json/package.docker.json pair, listed here only to keep the batch's rationale in one place), qs 6.16.0 (GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g and GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx — transitive via express/body-parser, production; supersedes the 6.15.2 pin; no express 4.x declares a qs range reaching 6.16.0 — 4.22.0 asks for ~6.14.0 — so the override deliberately runs express one minor ahead of its own pin, as it already did at 6.15.2), body-parser 1.20.8 (GHSA-v422-hmwv-36x6 — production; 1.20.8 rather than the advisory's 1.20.6 because 1.20.6 still asks for qs ~6.15.1 while 1.20.8 asks for ~6.16.0 and therefore accepts the qs pin), express 4.22.0 (no advisory of its own, production — raised from 4.20.0 solely because 4.20.x and 4.21.x pin body-parser to exactly 1.20.3; 4.22.0 is the smallest 4.x declaring a range, ~1.20.3, that accepts the body-parser pin, and the 4.x line is kept because express 5 is a breaking major), cookie 0.7.1 and serve-static 1.16.2 (production, both reach the images through express; the CVE-2024-47764 and CVE-2024-43800 floors are unchanged; raised only to the versions express 4.22.0 declares, ~0.7.1 and ~1.16.2, so the overrides no longer force express below its own dependency ranges), form-data >=4.0.6 <5 (HIGH — transitive via axios), http-proxy-middleware >=3.0.7 <4 (HIGH — the gateway's own proxy middleware), jws 3.2.3 (CVE-2025-65945 — HMAC verification, transitive via jsonwebtoken@9 in admin and @sap/xssec), fast-uri 3.1.6 (GHSA-jqff-g426-hqxp, GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc and GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf — path traversal + host confusion via ajv in admin, production: the admin image keeps ajv; supersedes the 3.1.2 pin), tar >=7.5.21 <8.0.0 (GHSA-r292-9mhp-454m plus the critical GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw — production: tar arrives through @cap-js/postgres and @cap-js/sqlite and survives the admin image's node_modules prune; bounded to 7.x, the current major), handlebars >=4.7.9 <5.0.0 (GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q critical plus seven more — eight rows in all: 1 critical, 4 high, 2 medium, 1 low — bounded to the current major; it sits in the production graph only because @sap/cds-dk is a runtime dependency of admin and pulls it through @sap/hdi-deploy (the other paths — ts-jest, ui5-tooling-modules — are dev-only), and the admin Dockerfile deletes handlebars from the copied node_modules, so nothing ships and this pin is belt-and-braces), morgan >=1.12.0 <2.0.0 (GHSA-jxfw-x594-9x9m and GHSA-4vj7-5mj6-jm8m — the gateway's request logger, production; bounded to 1.x), picomatch@2 2.3.2 and picomatch@4 4.0.4 (GHSA-c2c7-rcm5-vvqj and GHSA-3v7f-55p6-f55p ReDoS — production, both majors are in the tree so each gets its own pkg@major override key), @isaacs/brace-expansion >=5.0.1 <6.0.0 (GHSA-7h2j-956f-4vf2 ReDoS — it reached the admin image through minimatch@10; minimatch 10.2.6 has since moved back to plain brace-expansion@5, so nothing resolves to it today and the pin is a guard against it returning; bounded to 5.x), minimatch >=10.2.3 (GHSA-7r86-cg39-jmmj, GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74 and GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26 — production via @cap-js/* and ajv; supersedes the >=9.0.6 pin), nodemon>minimatch 3.1.4 (the same three advisories on the 3.x line — dev-only, nodemon cannot take minimatch 10), shell-quote >=1.9.0 (CVE-2026-9277 / GHSA-395f-4hp3-45gv — dev-only via npm-run-all, patched to keep the Dependabot dashboard clean; raised from the earlier >=1.8.4 pin because the advisory's vulnerable range is <=1.8.4 and its first patched version is 1.9.0). js-yaml is bounded >=4.3.2 <5.0.0 — the floor is GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh (with GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj and GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m, production via @cap-js/* and @sap/cds in the admin image), the <5 ceiling is required because js-yaml 5.x is ESM-only with no default export and breaks @ui5/project's `import jsyaml from 'js-yaml'` during the UI5 build. Other bounded overrides (path-to-regexp/router/send/tmp/got/follow-redirects) are silent CVE patches; lodash/underscore/ws/flatted are single-major dev-only patches added to clear the Dependabot dashboard (none ship to production); undici >=6.28.0 <7.0.0 is the same kind of dev-only patch — three medium advisories, all first patched in 6.28.0, raised from the earlier >=6.27.0 pin which cleared only the older ones; bounded to the 6.x line because undici 7 is a breaking major, and it is dev-only in this tree. Dev-only CVE pins from the same 2026-09 batch, every one bounded to the package's current major and none of them shipped — they are reachable only from the UI5 app builds and the test/lint tooling: fast-xml-parser@4 >=4.5.5 <5.0.0 and fast-xml-parser@5 >=5.5.7 <6.0.0 (GHSA-m7jm-9gc2-mpf2 critical plus GHSA-8gc5-j5rx-235r, GHSA-jmr7-xgp7-cmfj, GHSA-37qj-frw5-hhjh, GHSA-jp2q-39xq-3w4g, GHSA-gh4j-gqv2-49f6 and GHSA-fj3w-jwp8-x2g3 — the two floors differ because the advisories patch the two lines at different points: 4.5.5 clears the last 4.x advisory (GHSA-8gc5-j5rx-235r), while on the 5.x line GHSA-8gc5-j5rx-235r is first patched in 5.5.6 but GHSA-jp2q-39xq-3w4g only in 5.5.7, so the 5.x floor is 5.5.7; both majors are in the tree so each gets its own pkg@major override key: 4.x through @sap/ux-ui5-tooling (@sap-ux/axios-extension, @sap-ux/project-access, @sap-ux/odata-service-writer), 5.x through ui5-tooling-modules, @ui5/mcp-server and @ui5/linter), @xmldom/xmldom >=0.8.15 <0.9.0 (GHSA-c7q8-3ch8-vqpv, GHSA-27p8-2357-5qqv, GHSA-8344-3jmq-59r6, GHSA-x4fp-j954-r2f4, GHSA-965w-775f-mr7g, GHSA-93r5-fhx6-vmg9, GHSA-6h8r-xr42-gp59 and GHSA-6gmq-8vp8-gcm6 — dev-only through @sap/ux-ui5-tooling's @sap-ux/axios-extension; the <0.9 ceiling keeps it on the 0.8 line the advisory patches), @modelcontextprotocol/sdk >=1.26.0 <2.0.0 (GHSA-345p-7cg4-v4c7, GHSA-8r9q-7v3j-jr4g and GHSA-w48q-cv73-mx4w — dev-only through @ui5/mcp-server), linkify-it >=5.0.2 <6.0.0 (GHSA-v245-v573-v5vm and GHSA-22p9-wv53-3rq4 — dev-only through markdown-it inside jsdoc inside @ui5/builder), ip-address >=10.3.1 <11.0.0 (GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr and GHSA-v2v4-37r5-5v8g — dev-only through socks/socks-proxy-agent under the npm fetch stack that @ui5/project's pacote uses), rollup >=4.59.0 <5.0.0 (GHSA-mw96-cpmx-2vgc — dev-only, ui5-tooling-modules bundles the app dependencies with it), browserslist >=4.28.7 <5.0.0 (GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx and GHSA-73wf-gq98-2v4g — dev-only through ui5-tooling-transpile and @babel/helper-compilation-targets), @babel/plugin-transform-modules-systemjs >=7.29.4 <8.0.0 (GHSA-fv7c-fp4j-7gwp — dev-only through @babel/preset-env under ui5-tooling-transpile), brace-expansion@1 >=1.1.18 <2.0.0, brace-expansion@2 >=2.1.4 <3.0.0 and brace-expansion@5 >=5.0.9 <6.0.0 (GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895, GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg and GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp ReDoS — dev-only: the 1.x line arrives through nodemon's minimatch@3 and the 5.x line through minimatch@10 under eslint, glob, copyfiles, npm-run-all and the UI5 tooling; the @2 key is a guard — nothing in this tree resolves to that major today, but the npm-dist lockfile still carries 2.x alerts). @cap-js/* pins are supply-chain attack guards from April 2025 (NOT CVE patches). Dev-only acceptances (still in tree, not shipped to production): glob 10.4.5 via copyfiles+@ui5/mcp-server (cannot upgrade without breaking copyfiles@2.4.1 ESM gap), path-to-regexp 0.1.13 ReDoS (router@2.x compat, route patterns are static), pacote 19.0.1 (fix is 21.x, a major under @ui5/mcp-server and ui5-tooling-modules), sigstore 3.1.0 (fix 4.1.1, a major), @sigstore/core 2.0.0 (medium, everything <=3.2.0 is vulnerable — a consequence of the accepted sigstore 3.1.0, which pins the 2.x core), adm-zip 0.5.10 (fix 0.6.0, @sap/ux-ui5-tooling), serialize-javascript 6.0.2 (fix 7.x, ui5-tooling-modules; pruned from the admin image), extract-zip (no fix, puppeteer) — none ship; plus 50+ transitive dev highs through @ui5/mcp-server, nodemon, npm-run-all, ts-jest, eslint, @babel/preset-env, ui5-tooling-modules, @sap/ux-ui5-tooling — none ship to Docker images or the npm tarball. After changing overrides, run `node cli-tools/refresh-dist-lockfiles.js` to refresh the docker/ and npm-dist/ lockfiles so Dependabot rescans the patched versions.
